question: How much compensation do I get in the UK for a short flight delayed 3 hours?
rule: Under the UK version of Regulation (EC) No 261/2004, passengers on flights of 1,500 kilometres or less who arrive three hours or more late are entitled to compensation of £220.

question: Do US airlines have to refund me if my international flight is delayed 7 hours?
rule: Under the US Department of Transportation's 2024 refund rule, airlines must provide automatic cash refunds when an international flight's departure or arrival changes by more than six hours.

question: How long do I have to dispute a credit card billing error in the US?
rule: Under the Fair Credit Billing Act, a consumer must send written notice of a billing error to the creditor within 60 days after the creditor transmitted the first statement containing the error.

question: Can I cancel something I bought from a door-to-door salesperson in the US?
rule: Under the FTC's Cooling-Off Rule, a buyer may cancel a door-to-door sale of $25 or more until midnight of the third business day after the transaction.

question: When does a debt collector have to send me a validation notice in the US?
rule: Under section 809 of the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act, a debt collector must send a written validation notice within five days after the initial communication with a consumer.

question: What is the US federal minimum wage?
rule: Under section 6 of the Fair Labor Standards Act, the federal minimum wage is $7.25 per hour.

question: How long does my landlord in California have to return my deposit?
rule: Under California Civil Code section 1950.5, a landlord must return the security deposit, with an itemized statement of deductions, within 21 days after the tenant vacates.

question: How long does my landlord in New York have to return my deposit?
rule: Under New York General Obligations Law section 7-108, a landlord must return the security deposit with an itemized statement within 14 days after the tenant vacates.

question: How much notice must my New York landlord give before a big rent increase?
rule: Under New York Real Property Law section 226-c, a landlord must give 90 days' notice before increasing rent by 5% or more for a tenant who has occupied the unit for more than two years.

question: How much can a landlord in Germany raise rent in three years?
rule: Under section 558(3) of the German Civil Code (BGB), rent may not be increased by more than 20 percent within three years, with a 15 percent cap in designated tight housing markets.
